definitionZh: 连字符限制-chars CSS 属性指定最小的字长,以允许单词的连字符,以及连字符前后的最小字符数.
sourceDefinition: The hyphenate-limit-chars CSS property specifies the minimum word length to allow hyphenation of words as well as the minimum number of characters before and after the hyphen.
